title: Wolves up close
why: A real public post captured on 2026-11-16. Counts are as captured; videos are stills.

post.text:
From harsh conditions to rival predators, these wolves face danger at every turn. But one of their greatest struggles may also be the simplest: finding enough food to survive.

#WolvesUpClose with @bertiegregory is now streaming on @DisneyPlus and @hulu.
